settings.hitlApprovalPointsNote: These settings control how an approval behaves. Which points in a discussion require approval is configured per phase in the Manager.
settings.deliberationDesc: Capture minority views and let members file work they discover mid-discussion
settings.recordDissentsDesc: After each synthesis, every member who did not write it gets one short turn to state where they still disagree. Costs one extra call per member.
settings.agentFiledTasks: Let members file their own tasks
settings.agentFiledTasksDesc: Work an agent discovers mid-discussion becomes a real task the next execution wave picks up. Off means the tools do not exist for this group at all.
settings.maxTasksPerDiscussionHelp: Counts only agent-filed tasks, so a large planned backlog does not exhaust it.
settings.maxTasksPerTurnHelp: Bounds a runaway single turn; the discussion cap bounds slow drift.
settings.maxCostHelp: Leave empty for no limit. A turn already in flight can still push the total slightly past the ceiling.
settings.costSynthesize: Synthesize now — skip ahead to the conclusion
settings.costCeilingInvalid: A cost ceiling must be greater than 0. Clear the field for no limit.
settings.maxDelegationDepthHelp: A delegating to B delegating to C is depth 2. The hop that would exceed this is refused — this is what stops a delegation cycle.
settings.delegationTimeoutHelp: How long a delegating agent waits for its delegate. Raise it when the delegate runs tools or a nested discussion.
settings.allowedDelegationTargetsHelp: Comma-separated agent IDs. Leave empty to allow any deployed agent.
settings.moderatorlessWarning: Restricted to a moderator this task force does not have: {{phases}}. The first member by speaking order will stand in.
settings.memberLimit: A task force can hold at most {{max}} members
settings.explicitPhasesNote: This task force defines its phases explicitly ({{phases}}), so those run as written — the framework and round count above no longer change the flow.
settings.deleteAllSuccess: Task force and all agents deleted
